About this service

This service might be right for you if:

  • You are choosing a legal structure for a business.
  • You need formation documents, operating agreements or business contracts.
  • You want to assess trademark protection for a name or brand.
  • Your business is changing, growing or restructuring.

What we cover

What business & trademark services include

Business formation
Entity selection, formation and organisational documents.
Business agreements
Operating agreements, contracts and ownership considerations.
Trademark protection
Strategy, preliminary searches and federal applications.
Trademark maintenance
Renewals, ownership changes and portfolio guidance.
